notes: Review order, not a ranking by outcome.
Question "explore": nothing is ranked. Variants are listed by |effect| / floor, descending, where the effect is the insulin asked for vs base (rise or rest, whichever is larger against its floor).

Feasible = no more insulin than base plus the floor in the two hours before a recorded low on every day, inside the envelope on every day (at most 1.0 U vs base in any 3 h window and 15.0 % of the phone's TDD per day), no emulated SMB above the phone's maxBolus, factor on a cap in fewer than 50.0 % of loops, loop count equal to base. Infeasible variants are shown greyed with the reason, never ranked.

Floor per day and component = |base - phone|; a difference smaller than 2 x floor is a tie (grey). Variants inside the floor on every component are indistinguishable from base within the noise floor; parameters with every point inside the floor on all days are not testable on these days.

Recommended for review only if feasible on all days, top-3 on at least 80 % of the leave-one-day-out folds, the same sign of the primary effect on at least 80 % of days, and within the top 5 on the hold-out days. Settings are for you and your care team to review; nothing here changes the phone.
